Content: `text(Two)` blocks are stacked on top of each other, as shown in the figure above. The top block, of mass `M`, is attached to a rope that pulls to the left with tension `T_1`. The bottom block, of mass `2M`, is attached to a rope that pulls to the right with tension `T_2`. The coefficient of friction between the blocks is `mu`. The blocks are at rest relative to each other and move to the right at constant speed relative to the frictionless surface.
